code: library(transformerpalettes)  # what is covered tf_media() tf_factions() tf_teams() table(tf_characters$team, tf_characters$medium)  # palette names, optionally for one faction, team or role tf_palette_names() tf_palette_names(team = "Constructicons") tf_palette_names(role = "combined form")  # the colours of one character (prints the swatches and the hex codes) tf_palette("optimus_prime") #> Transformers palette 'optimus_prime' (5 colours, toy) #> Autobot: Optimus Prime #> #D0202A #1F3E8F #B8BABF #F2D23C #2D2D2D  # first three colours, a 12-step gradient, or the same gradient dark-to-light tf_palette("Megatron", 3) tf_palette("devastator", 12, type = "continuous") tf_palette("hot_spot", 12, type = "continuous", sort = TRUE)  # swatches with hex codes, for a team or faction at a time tf_show_palettes(team = "Aerialbots") tf_show_palettes(faction = "Decepticon", role = "combined form", ncol = 3)

what: Finding a palette that works for a plot
title: transformerpalettes - Generation 1 Transformers palettes for R
text: Toy colours chosen look good shelf, chart. tf_find_palettes() shortlists palettes whose colours hold given job, judged colours : judgments come tf_palette_stats(), reports smallest pairwise distance colours CIE Lab, simulating deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia, lightness range, hue spread. thresholds simple heuristics, treat result shortlist look rather guarantee.
code: tf_find_palettes("categorical")   # every pair of colours clearly distinct tf_find_palettes("colorblind")    # still distinct under simulated CVD tf_find_palettes("sequential")    # one hue, wide lightness range tf_find_palettes("diverging")     # two hues with a light colour between  # restrict to a faction or team, or see the shortlist as swatches tf_find_palettes("colorblind", faction = "Autobot") tf_show_palettes(use = "colorblind", ncol = 3)

what: Picking the best few colours from one or more palettes
title: transformerpalettes - Generation 1 Transformers palettes for R
text: Whole palettes faithful characters, chart. tf_pick() pools colours palettes name, drops read background (white "light" "greyscale", near-black "dark", judged WCAG contrast), chooses n colours whose closest pair farthest apart CIE Lab. colorblind = TRUE distance worst case across simulated deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia; style = "greyscale" lightness counts, result survives black--white printer. colour named palette came , min_distance attribute reports separable closest pair (20 comfortable, 12 risky). contrast filter strict purpose: saturated yellows fail white, light-mode pick Predacons fewer colours work . Lower min_contrast keep , pass different background.
code: # five colours for a white-background plot, from the two leaders tf_pick(c("optimus_prime", "megatron"), n = 5) #> Transformers pick of 5 colours from optimus_prime + megatron #> light background #FFFFFF, min distance 21.7 #> optimus_prime = #D0202A #> optimus_prime = #1F3E8F #> megatron = #8C9095 #> megatron = #2A2A2A #> megatron = #6B3FA0  # four colour-blind-safe colours for a dark theme, from a whole team tf_pick(tf_palette_names(team = "Combaticons"), n = 4,         style = "dark", colorblind = TRUE)  # printable in greyscale, using the cartoon colours tf_pick(tf_palette_names(team = "Stunticons"), n = 4,         style = "greyscale", medium = "cartoon")  ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = drv)) +   geom_point(size = 2.5) +   scale_colour_manual(values = unname(tf_pick(c("optimus_prime", "megatron"), 3)))

title: transformerpalettes 0.2.0
text: package now called transformerpalettes (started life transformeRs). Function names unchanged; reinstall pak::pak("bmaitner/transformerpalettes"). old GitHub URL redirects. Palettes now record medium: every character toy palette (original release), every character cartoon palette (Sunbow animation model, Masterforce model Seacons), Optimus Prime Megatron comic palette (Marvel). Cartoon comic palettes keyed <name>_cartoon <name>_comic, tf_characters gains base medium columns. 118 palettes total. New medium argument tf_palette(), tf_palette_names(), tf_team_palette(), tf_show_palettes(), tf_find_palettes() ggplot2 scales, defaulting "toy" existing code unchanged; "" lists every medium. New tf_media(). Cartoon palettes link episode still Transformers Wiki reference image; palette browser gains Medium filter badge. Corrected toy palettes Cutthroat, Drag Strip Vortex toy photos. New tf_pick() selects n distinguishable colours one palettes light, dark greyscale plot, optionally requiring stay distinct simulated colour-vision deficiency. Colours fail WCAG contrast check background dropped first; subset chosen maximise smallest pairwise CIE Lab distance. Comic palettes combiner teams queued WISHLIST.md rather guessed; Marvel colouring varies issue, cite issue sampled .
